clue.text: Weapon may recoil awkwardly if one is abstracted

indicators.note: awkwardly says the letters of may recoil are to be rearranged into a clumsy new order

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A warning that a weapon may kick back clumsily if someone walks off with it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'if one is abstracted' tells you the I (one) is taken away: the letters of MAY RECOIL, rearranged ('awkwardly'), give the answer plus an I left over.
explanation.definitionFit: A claymore is a large two-edged Scottish broadsword, a kind of weapon.

clue.text: Copper gets money out of East End thief

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

indicators.note: End picks only the final letter of the word East

parts.note: out of puts the money word following on from the end letter

explanation.surface: A policeman extracts cash from a criminal in London's East End.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Copper' looks like a policeman but is the metal, chemical symbol CU; the East End is the traditionally working-class east of London.
explanation.definitionFit: A cutpurse is an old word for a pickpocket, one who robs by cutting purse strings.

clue.text: Sailor abroad has to translate military order

parts.note: AB is able seaman, a sailor
abroad can mean out, out and about
to turn a text into another language is to translate it

explanation.surface: A sailor overseas must interpret a command from the army.
explanation.definitionFit: An about-turn is a drill command to face the opposite direction.

clue.text: I object to general brawl

parts.note: me is I used as the object of a verb
Robert E. Lee was the Confederate general

explanation.surface: Someone protesting about a general fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'I object' is grammar, not protest: the objective case of I is ME.
explanation.definitionFit: A melee is a confused fight involving many people.

clue.text: More offensive talk causing resentment

indicators.note: talk says the comparative word is heard spoken, giving a similar sound

parts.note: ranker means more rank, more offensive or foul

explanation.surface: Ruder talk breeding bitterness.
explanation.definitionFit: Rancour is bitter, long-lasting ill will.

clue.text: Fruitful investment by City in stock

indicators.note: in places the City's postcode letters inside the word for stock

parts.note: a fund is a stock or supply of something
EC is the postal district of the City of London

explanation.surface: A profitable investment made in the City's stock market.
explanation.walkthrough: 'investment' suggests finance but just joins; the City (London's financial district) has the postcode EC.
explanation.definitionFit: Fecund means fertile or productive, bearing fruit plentifully.

clue.text: Divert to take on board

explanation.surface: Amuse someone by putting them on a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: To entertain is to amuse; it is also to consider or hold an idea in mind.

clue.text: Head off foot trouble exposing joint

indicators.note: head off means the leading letter is removed

parts.note: a bunion is a painful swelling on the foot

explanation.surface: Treating a bunion reveals the joint of the toe beneath.
explanation.definitionFit: A union is a coupling or connection, as in a pipe fitting.

clue.text: Pursued with tenacity

explanation.surface: Followed persistently.
explanation.definitionFit: Dogged means followed closely, tailed; as an adjective it means stubbornly persistent.

clue.text: Father getting over split from mother, say

indicators.note: getting over in a down clue puts the father word on top of the split word

parts.note: pa is a familiar word for father
a rent is a tear or split

explanation.surface: A dad coming to terms with his separation from the children's mother.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mother, say' is the definition by example.
explanation.definitionFit: A mother is one example of someone with a child.

clue.text: Charge when netting river fish

indicators.note: netting means catching inside, so the river letter is caught within the charge

parts.note: a toll is a charge for using a road or bridge

explanation.surface: An angler pays a fee for the right to catch fish in a river.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fish' looks like a noun ending the picture but is a verb: to troll is to fish by trailing a line behind a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: To troll is to angle by drawing a baited line through the water.

clue.text: Making electrics safe after number in narrow escape

indicators.note: after places the electrical term behind the number abbreviation in the answer

parts.note: earthing is connecting a circuit to the ground so it is safe

explanation.surface: An electrician wiring things safely after a close shave with a live circuit.
explanation.walkthrough: EARTHING is British for what Americans call grounding.
explanation.definitionFit: A near thing is a close call, something that almost went wrong.

clue.text: Unbalanced article introducing staff at University opening

indicators.note: opening puts the university term at the start of the answer
introducing places the article in front of the staff word

parts.note: up means in residence at university, especially Oxford or Cambridge
the is the definite article
a pole is a long staff or rod

explanation.surface: A wobbly opening ceremony at a university where staff are introduced.
explanation.walkthrough: UP THE POLE is British slang for crazy or mistaken; 'up' means at university in British usage.
explanation.definitionFit: Up the pole is informal British slang for mad or mentally off balance.

clue.text: Get up around noon and wash

indicators.note: around has the rising word wrapped about the letter for noon

parts.note: to rise is to get up

explanation.surface: A lazy morning: get out of bed at midday and have a wash.
explanation.definitionFit: To rinse something is to wash it lightly in clean water.

clue.text: Meal includes cold dish

indicators.note: includes means the meal word holds the cold abbreviation inside it

parts.note: supper is an evening meal
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: An evening meal featuring a cold plate of food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dish' looks like a plate of food but is the verb: to dish someone's hopes is to ruin them.
explanation.definitionFit: To scupper a plan is to wreck or ruin it, as to dish it does.

clue.text: Foremost soldier to get up on horseback

parts.note: a para is a paratrooper, a soldier
to mount is to climb onto a horse

explanation.surface: The leading soldier climbs into the saddle.
explanation.definitionFit: Paramount means supreme, chief in importance.

clue.text: Paintings returned, withdrawn as worthless

indicators.note: returned means the art word is read backwards

parts.note: paintings are art
a withdrawn person is shy, reserved

explanation.surface: Pictures sent back by a gallery, pulled from sale because they are judged worthless.
explanation.walkthrough: The held text's '3' is a stray mark from the page margin. 'returned' turns ART into TRA.
explanation.definitionFit: Trashy goods are cheap and of poor quality, of little value.

clue.text: Larks in chestnut, possibly, make music

parts.note: a chestnut is a reddish-brown horse, one example
to play is to make music

explanation.surface: Fun with a conker, or music played inside a chestnut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chestnut' suggests the nut or an old joke but here is a horse of that colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Larks are pranks, boisterous fooling about.

clue.text: Versatile, as was Drake's journey

explanation.surface: A talented person compared with Drake's voyage.
explanation.definitionFit: All-round means skilled in many areas; Francis Drake sailed right round the world, circling the globe.

clue.text: Retired, holding reception initially — that's natural

indicators.note: holding means the retired phrase keeps the initial letter inside it

parts.note: someone who has retired for the night is in bed

indicators.note: initially takes only the opening letter of reception

explanation.surface: A guest went to bed early, skipping the reception, and claims it was only natural.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Retired' suggests leaving work but means going to bed: IN BED.
explanation.definitionFit: An inbred quality is innate, deeply ingrained from birth.

clue.text: Notes impounded by court put up to meet costs

indicators.note: impounded by means the notes are shut inside the court word
put up in a down clue means the court word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a yard is a courtyard, an enclosed court
E and F are musical notes

explanation.surface: Banknotes seized by a court and offered to pay the expenses.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put up' turns YARD into DRAY; 'Notes' suggests money but means musical notes E and F.
explanation.definitionFit: To defray is to pay for expenses.

clue.text: Some tungsten drills incorporated in plant

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Tungsten drill bits being built into the machinery of a factory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plant' suggests a factory using the drills, but it is a botanical plant, of which the answer is a part.
explanation.definitionFit: A tendril is a slender climbing shoot forming part of a vine or similar plant.

clue.text: Anguish suffered by people in wrong

indicators.note: in places the people word inside the legal wrong

parts.note: a tort is a civil wrong in law
men are people

explanation.surface: Distress felt by people who have been wronged.
explanation.definitionFit: Torment is severe mental or physical suffering.

clue.text: Schoolmaster is inside for break

indicators.note: inside puts the word is within the schoolmaster abbreviation

parts.note: SchM is a dictionary abbreviation for schoolmaster

explanation.surface: A teacher is indoors during the school break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'break' is not playtime but a split, a division.
explanation.definitionFit: A schism is a split or division, especially within a church.

clue.text: Entrance for church member

parts.note: an arm is a limb, a member of the body

explanation.surface: A doorway reserved for someone belonging to the church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Entrance' reads as a doorway but is the verb en-TRANCE, to enchant.
explanation.definitionFit: To charm someone is to delight or enchant them, as to entrance does.

clue.text: Sailors have a party on deck

indicators.note: on in a down clue places the party above the sailors

parts.note: a do is a party
RN is the Royal Navy, sailors

explanation.surface: Sailors hold a party on the ship's deck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deck' is not the ship's floor but the verb, to decorate.
explanation.definitionFit: To deck is to decorate or embellish.

clue.text: Prime equipment enabling one to start climbing

parts.note: prime means first in rank or order
gear is equipment or kit

explanation.surface: Top-quality kit that lets a mountaineer begin an ascent.
explanation.walkthrough: The climbing is done by a car on a hill, not a mountaineer: the lowest gear is used to move off and to climb steep slopes.
explanation.definitionFit: The lowest ratio in a vehicle gearbox is used for pulling away and for steep hills.

clue.text: Get slimmer and lighter

explanation.surface: Lose weight and become lighter.
explanation.definitionFit: To taper is to narrow gradually; a taper is also a thin candle or spill used for lighting.

clue.text: Not a clue one contrived to inject

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: contrived means put together artificially, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A clueless person cooks up a way to give someone an injection.
explanation.definitionFit: To inoculate is to inject a vaccine to give immunity.

clue.text: Starts wo prepare ingredients launching an unusual rice dish

indicators.note: starts to tells you to take the first letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: Getting the ingredients ready to launch an unusual rice dish.
explanation.definitionFit: A pilau is a spiced rice dish cooked in stock, of Middle Eastern origin.

clue.text: Not a lot to record

explanation.surface: Writing down only a little.
explanation.definitionFit: Minute means tiny, a small amount; to minute a meeting is to write down its proceedings.

clue.text: Destroyer mostly refitted in stages

indicators.note: refitted means rebuilt, so the letters of the warship are rearranged
mostly means all but the final letter of destroyer is used

explanation.surface: A warship being refitted bit by bit over a period.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in stages' suggests a timeline but means built in floors, or levels.
explanation.definitionFit: A storeyed building has several floors or tiers, one above another.
